BiblicalUsage: Balaam goes with Balak, and they come to Kirjath-huzoth, the city of streets. One verse, one stop on the road to a blessing Balak did not want.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Balak's city of streets could not hold the prophet he hired, because God had already spoken.
